overview: The Medford School Committee approved the FY24 operating budget, finalized the superintendent's evaluation, and voted to publish it online. The committee also discussed a revised bullying prevention and intervention policy before voting to table its first reading until July 19, 2023.

items.title: Medford Public Schools Bullying Prevention and Intervention Policy
items.summary: Following debate over statutory definitions and a minor punctuation amendment, the committee voted to table the first reading of the updated bullying prevention policy until July 19, 2023, so members could finish reviewing the document.

items.title: 2022-2023 Superintendent Evaluation
items.summary: Approved the revised 2022-2023 superintendent evaluation following numerical corrections and an expanded member comment.

items.title: Posting of Superintendent Evaluation Online
items.summary: Approved a motion to post the finalized superintendent evaluation to the school committee page on the district website.

items.title: FY24 MPS Operating Budget
items.summary: Approved the fiscal year 2024 operating budget following discussions regarding non-unit salary increases, upcoming ESSER funding expiration, and efforts to recruit a chief financial officer.

items.title: Executive Session
items.summary: Voted to enter executive session regarding collective bargaining strategy, non-unit administrative contracts, and security personnel or devices without reconvening in open session.
